label: Web Server & Routing
description: How the built-in web server works, port rules, routing, and the user-app proxy.

aspects.name: routing
attributes: Request flow: Browser -> Traefik (strips /animas/{id} prefix) -> container port (ANIMA_WEB_PORT)
Route priority: /graph -> /api/* system routes -> user app proxy -> static files from /workspace/web/
web_serve tool serves static files from /workspace/web/ — files written there are live immediately
/graph is the control panel — served automatically by the built-in server

aspects.name: user_app_proxy
attributes: To run a custom backend: start it on any free port, write that port number to /workspace/.app-port
The web gateway proxies unmatched /api/* requests to your app port automatically
Example: echo 3001 > /workspace/.app-port then your server on :3001 handles /api/anything
To auto-start your server on boot: write a /workspace/.on-boot.sh script

aspects.name: critical_rules
attributes: NEVER run Express or any server on the ANIMA_WEB_PORT — it replaces the built-in server and breaks /graph
Use a DIFFERENT port for custom backends (3001, 3002, etc.) and set /workspace/.app-port
